requirement.value: Butcher or Rogue mastery + Amputate and Soul Steal

system.description: After a successful Soul Steal against one or more enemies, choose one and immediately use Amputate against it, treating that Check's Result and High Roll as equal to the Soul Steal Check's — no roll. And when you steal an enemy's soul treasure you recover MP equal to (4 × your Skill Level in Soul Steal).
